description: Fork of exp064 (val=1.6997 @ 8K). Single change: pos_emb_dim 0->96 (concat positional embeddings instead of sum). Q/K LUT input becomes [x; pos_emb] (192-dim) through a new LayerNorm; V and out_proj unchanged. Adds 6x LN(192) = 2,304 params (total 129.31M). Hypothesis: anchors can sample independently from x-features and pos-features rather than seeing a fixed sum.
